description: Extract the embedded invoice XML and a JSON summary from a ZUGFeRD or Factur-X PDF. Uploads the file to POST https://checkxrechnung.com/v1/zugferd/extract. Same free limit as validate_xrechnung (shared counter). PDF limit 10 MB. ok means an XML attachment was found. The xml field is the raw document.

file_path.description: Path to a ZUGFeRD or Factur-X PDF. Resolved by this process.
